explicit_validation.explanation: The paper uses GPT-4o as an LLM-based fact-checker and conducts human evaluation on LEGALSUMM dataset, but does not compare or validate LLM judgments against human judgments. Both methods are presented as separate baseline systems without any correlation analysis or agreement metrics.

prompts.notes: The paper mentions using 'a prompt adopted from Tang et al. (2024)' but does not show the exact prompt text. References to Appendix E suggest prompt details may be available there.

guidelines.notes: Human annotators selected from four choices justifying factual consistency and provided free-text rationales. Guidelines were refined through multiple sessions and in-person resolution of inconsistencies. Figure in Appendix shows annotation guideline.

criteria_mapping.notes: Both LLM (GPT4o) and human evaluators assess factual consistency, but they evaluated different datasets - LLM evaluated multiple benchmarks while human evaluation focused specifically on LEGALSUMM dataset. No direct comparison was made between LLM and human judgments on the same instances.
